mask.title: Edit mask
mask.infoText: The lasso selects everything inside the loop; the brush selects only what it paints over. The blue overlay is the actual selection.
mask.infoTextKeep: Paint the area to keep; erase to take it back out of the keep area.
mask.hintLasso: Draw a loop; it closes on release and selects what is inside
mask.hintBrush: Paint the area to select; an outline alone does not select the inside
mask.hintEraser: Erase the parts of the selection you do not want changed

settings.noRewriteHint: Send the prompt as written; gateways won't rewrite it.

placeholders.agent: Tell me what you want to create, or share a script or reference image. I’ll help shape the idea and plan the next steps.
placeholders.image: Describe the subject, setting and visual style. Add reference images to guide the composition, colors or details.
placeholders.video: Describe the action, camera movement and changing atmosphere. Add a reference image to give your video a starting point.
